definitions: Disqualified (oneself or another judge, prosecutor, or juror) from participating in a case because of a potential conflict of interest or lack of impartiality.
Challenged or objected to a judge, prosecutor, or juror on the grounds of their unsuitability or bias.
examples: The judge recused himself due to a family connection.
The prosecutor was recused from the case.
The juror was recused after admitting bias.
